description: Mirage IIIEA c/n 6F/6D delivered 5 May 1973, a 1982 combat veteran, retired 29 November 2015; arrived 18 May 2018 and erected at the Paseo de la Estación (inaugurated 27 May 2023) as a monument to the FAA's Malvinas participants. Photographed 5 June 2024.
museum_name: Mirage IIIEA Malvinas Monument, Villa Ramallo
